تستعرضوا (form X)
# تَسْتَعْرِضُوا (tastaʕriḍū) /tas.taʕ.ri.dˤuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَعْرَضَ (istaʕraḍa)
# تُسْتَعْرَضُوا (tustaʕraḍū) /tus.taʕ.ra.dˤuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَعْرَضَ (istaʕraḍa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
